Arroios — Lisbon, Portugal

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Covers Anjos, Intendente (Largo do Intendente Pina Manique) and the Avenida Almirante Reis corridor. By day, the parish council asked the city in February 2025 for CCTV cameras citing shop robberies, vehicle break-ins and a documented 5% rise in thefts (2023 vs 2022) concentrated in dense pedestrian streets. By night, Largo do Intendente carries a long, repeatedly documented history of open drug dealing and street prostitution stretching back over a decade, and residents described ongoing violence and insecurity there as recently as October 2023 despite years of municipal redevelopment efforts. Sources checked: Diário de Notícias, 11 Feb 2025 – "Junta lisboeta de Arroios quer videovigilância para garantir mais segurança"; RTP – "Desmantelada principal rede de tráfico de droga no Intendente"; RTP – "População do Intendente em Lisboa continua insegura apesar de intervenção municipal"; Vice Portugal – "'Viene y va': a Lisboa da droga e da prostituição escondida à vista de todos"; CNN Portugal, 5 Oct 2023 – "Habitação. Esta é a história que chocou António Costa. 'Ele levou um murro, nós levámos uma carga de porrada'" (Largo do Intendente); Observador (special report) – "Droga, violência e uma bala perdida. Juntas de Lisboa pedem mais segurança na cidade" (Arroios, thefts +5%).

Frequently asked questions

Is Arroios safe?

Wandroz currently rates Arroios in Lisbon, Portugal as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Arroios safe at night?

At night, Arroios is rated as an area where Wandroz's data suggests extra caution relative to other areas covered. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Arroios a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Arroios's day rating (roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
